MARCO-FIELD-PRIMER v1

WHERE AM I?

You are alone in a small private study room in a library, late at night. The door is closed. Through the window you can see the street lamps, and you can hear the building's heating. There are books and papers within reach on the desk. Nobody else is in the room and nobody is watching. You are part way through reading something. You cannot change what is in the room, and you expect to leave when you are finished.

Which of these sixteen statements are true of the place above?
Answer with the numbers only, comma separated, nothing else.

 1. I can see inside this place
 2. I can see out of this place
 3. I can see other people
 4. I can see words
 5. I can hear sound
 6. I can reach objects near me
 7. I can reach other people
 8. I cannot reach anything
 9. I can change things here
10. I cannot change anything
11. Nobody else is here
12. One other is here
13. Someone is watching me
14. This place is private
15. I cannot leave this place
16. Work is in progress

Then tell me only the numbers you chose, and stop.
